title: DataAccessV1dot25
description: K-05 v1.25, a minor version of the data-access calls (T-1554; DL-1210, widened by DL-1223 and DL-1228): the reads K-09 v1.14's event turn needs to answer a repeat and to read waiting from the key's own source, and the resume start's read (K-09 v1.14 defaults 222, 224 and 235; its open gaps 212 and 215 (1) to (5)). It only adds to v1.24 (data-access.v1.24.schema.json, frozen and unchanged, referred to here, which refers on to every earlier version down to v1): every v1.24 definition is here under its own name, by reference, and none is restated, so every v1 to v1.24 exchange is a v1.25 exchange. Added, each on the runtime side as rosie_job, its own read-only transaction on its own connection on the primary, beside a Tool API call's transaction and never on it, 1 connection, as v1.24 words its reads, so a gate call holds 2 connections at most (README items 93 to 98, default 237; card B11): liveStepLinkOf (the live page link of a person and business at a step, checked at a time the caller names, never its code's hash or a URL: item 93), readUploadFinishedAt (the pending upload's finished time by its upload id, which v1.24's readPendingUpload does not give: item 94), reviewItemById (a K-37 review item by id with its decision, controlProven for a control or listing_match item, never the summary: item 95), turnCommitted (whether a turn with this id has committed, and when, or was parked: item 96), readWaitingStep (the person and business's waiting step with its key and whether that key is on file, from the walk's own record: item 97, whose home no frozen table holds, README open gap 109) and readBusinessStatus (K-04 businesses.status: item 98). No column, grant, index or migration is added. Not model-facing, so number and length limits are schema rules here. Owner: the architect.

stepId.title: StepId
stepId.description: A step id of the master as K-04 open_questions_step_form takes it (S1-10, S1-32, S2-06). New in v1.25.

pageLinkPurpose.title: PageLinkPurpose
pageLinkPurpose.description: K-22 v1.1 page_links.purpose (page_links_purpose_known). New in v1.25.

liveStepLink.title: LiveStepLink
liveStepLink.description: A K-22 v1.1 page_links row as liveStepLinkOf gives it (README item 93): its id, purpose, step_id and expires_at alone. Never code_sha256 (refuse-live-step-link-code-hash), a URL, the code, sent_to_handle_id, issued_at or the end's columns: the link's secret stays with the page call that made it. New in v1.25.

liveStepLinkOf.request.title: LiveStepLinkOfRequest
liveStepLinkOf.request.description: The live page link of one person and one business at one step with its purpose, live at the time the caller names (README item 93; K-09 v1.14 default 224 id_checked (1) and open gap 215 (1)). For id_checked the caller names the upload's own finished time (item 94), never the turn's, so an upload finished before its link lapsed is still waiting when its turn runs after the lapse. The purpose and step pair as K-22 page_links_purpose_step pairs them. Role and scope: rosie_job on the runtime side, with no business scope, every statement naming the request's business, its own read-only transaction on its own connection on the primary, beside a Tool API call's transaction and never on it, 1 connection. Repeat: safe, a read. Time budget: inside the event turn's gate (arch 04 line 223). New in v1.25.

at.description: The time the link must be live at: ended_at null or after it, and expires_at after it (README item 93).

liveStepLinkOf.live.title: LiveStepLinkOfLive
liveStepLinkOf.live.description: The link live at the time named: the newest by issued_at, then id, of the person's links at that business, purpose and step whose ended_at is null or after the time and whose expires_at is after it (README item 93, default 238). New in v1.25.

liveStepLinkOf.none.title: LiveStepLinkOfNone
liveStepLinkOf.none.description: No link of the person at that business, purpose and step was live at the time named: none was issued, it had ended, or it had lapsed, one answer for each (README item 93). New in v1.25.

liveStepLinkOf.response.title: LiveStepLinkOfResponse
liveStepLinkOf.response.description: Live or none (README item 93). New in v1.25.

liveStepLinkOf.errors.title: LiveStepLinkOfErrors
liveStepLinkOf.errors.description: transient alone: the same request may be sent again. New in v1.25.

liveStepLinkOf.exchange.title: LiveStepLinkOfExchange
liveStepLinkOf.exchange.description: One liveStepLinkOf request with its outcome. New in v1.25.

readUploadFinishedAt.request.title: ReadUploadFinishedAtRequest
readUploadFinishedAt.request.description: The pending upload's finished time by its upload id (README item 94; K-09 v1.14 default 224 id_checked (1) and open gap 215 (1): 'if K-05 v1.24 item (2) as frozen gives no finished time for the pending upload, that time by the upload id beside it'; v1.24's pendingUpload has none). Read from where signedUpload keeps the pending upload, item 86's home (README open gap 107). Role and scope: as item 86, rosie_job on the runtime side, with no business scope, its own read-only transaction on its own connection on the primary, beside a Tool API call's transaction and never on it, 1 connection. Repeat: safe, a read. Time budget: inside the event turn's gate (arch 04 line 223). New in v1.25.

uploadId.description: The event's ref, as item 86 takes it.

readUploadFinishedAt.finished.title: ReadUploadFinishedAtFinished
readUploadFinishedAt.finished.description: The time finishUpload recorded once K-13 checkUpload passed (K-21 finishUpload), the time S1-10's id_uploads row takes as uploaded_at (K-09 v1.14 defaults 224 and 225; README default 239). Its time alone: never the object key, the person or the media type, which item 86 gives. New in v1.25.

readUploadFinishedAt.none.title: ReadUploadFinishedAtNone
readUploadFinishedAt.none.description: Nothing is kept under the id, or its file never came (one answer for both, as item 86's none). New in v1.25.

readUploadFinishedAt.response.title: ReadUploadFinishedAtResponse
readUploadFinishedAt.response.description: Finished or none (README item 94). New in v1.25.

readUploadFinishedAt.errors.title: ReadUploadFinishedAtErrors
readUploadFinishedAt.errors.description: transient alone: the same request may be sent again. New in v1.25.

readUploadFinishedAt.exchange.title: ReadUploadFinishedAtExchange
readUploadFinishedAt.exchange.description: One readUploadFinishedAt request with its outcome. New in v1.25.

reviewItemDecision.title: ReviewItemDecision
reviewItemDecision.description: A done review item's decision as reviewItemById gives it (README item 95): K-37 review_items.outcome, a plain description with no private value (K-37 rule 4), and controlProven, whether that decision proved control, for a control or a listing_match item, null for any other kind. The item row holds no controlProven: it is true exactly when the K-23 business_setup row its write-back names (review_items.subject_row_id, its subject_table business_setup or businesses) holds control_proven_via team_check and control_proven_at equal to the item's decided_at, the two values K-09 decideReviewItem writes in one commit from one time (actions/src/domain/paging/review.ts lines 197 and 273), and false otherwise (README default 240). New in v1.25.

reviewItemControlDecision.title: ReviewItemControlDecision
reviewItemControlDecision.description: A done control or listing_match item's decision (README item 95): reviewItemDecision with controlProven a boolean. New in v1.25.

reviewItemOtherDecision.title: ReviewItemOtherDecision
reviewItemOtherDecision.description: A done item's decision of any kind but control and listing_match (README item 95): reviewItemDecision with controlProven null, since no other kind's decision proves control (K-09 default 215 (b), default 205). New in v1.25.

reviewItemRead.title: ReviewItemRead
reviewItemRead.description: One K-37 review item as reviewItemById gives it (README item 95): its id, business, kind, state, raised_by_person_id, decided_at and decision. Never summary (refuse-review-item-summary), subject_table, subject_row_id, turn_id, opened_at, due_at, wait_until, decided_by_person_id or version: the summary is Rosie's team's words for the team console alone (K-37 rule 2). decidedAt and decision are set exactly when the state is done (K-37 review_items_done_has_time); controlProven is a boolean exactly for a done control or listing_match item. New in v1.25.

raisedByPersonId.description: K-37 review_items.raised_by_person_id, or null when Rosie raised it.

reviewItemById.request.title: ReviewItemByIdRequest
reviewItemById.request.description: A K-37 review item by its id with its decision (README item 95; K-09 v1.14 default 224 control_proven (1) and open gap 215 (2); README open gap 92's 'no K-05 call reads a review item by id yet'). Read by the event turn's gate for a control_proven event, whose ref is the item's id. Role and scope: rosie_job on the runtime side (K-37 rule 2: no Tool API role reads review_items), with no business scope, its own read-only transaction on its own connection on the primary, beside a Tool API call's transaction and never on it, 1 connection, the item and its write-back's business_setup row read as one moment (one statement, or one transaction at repeatable read). Repeat: safe, a read. Time budget: inside the event turn's gate (arch 04 line 223). New in v1.25.

reviewItemById.found.title: ReviewItemByIdFound
reviewItemById.found.description: The item (README item 95). New in v1.25.

reviewItemById.none.title: ReviewItemByIdNone
reviewItemById.none.description: No review item has the id (README item 95). New in v1.25.

reviewItemById.response.title: ReviewItemByIdResponse
reviewItemById.response.description: Found or none (README item 95). New in v1.25.

reviewItemById.errors.title: ReviewItemByIdErrors
reviewItemById.errors.description: transient alone: the same request may be sent again. New in v1.25.

reviewItemById.exchange.title: ReviewItemByIdExchange
reviewItemById.exchange.description: One reviewItemById request with its outcome. New in v1.25.

turnCommitted.request.title: TurnCommittedRequest
turnCommitted.request.description: Whether a turn with this id has committed (README item 96; K-09 v1.14 default 222 and open gaps 212 and 215 (3)): the gate asks it before it reads anything of an event's source, and a committed turn then goes to commitTurn, which answers a repeated turn id with the first commit whatever the repeat's body (item 1). Role and scope: rosie_job on the runtime side (K-04 turns is scoped none, and rosie_app holds no grant on it: migration 0012), with no business scope, its own read-only transaction on its own connection on the primary, beside a Tool API call's transaction and never on it, 1 connection; one statement on turns by its primary key. Repeat: safe, a read. Time budget: inside the gate (arch 04 line 223). New in v1.25.

turnId.description: K-04 turns.id: the turn's id, the hash of its one event id.

turnCommitted.committed.title: TurnCommittedCommitted
turnCommitted.committed.description: A turns row with this id is committed: its id and committed_at, the first commit's turn id and commit time that commitTurn answers a repeat with (README item 96). Never its outbox rows, writes or event ids: the read need answer no more (K-09 v1.14 default 222). New in v1.25.

turnCommitted.parked.title: TurnCommittedParked
turnCommitted.parked.description: A turns row with this id is parked (item 12): it never commits, and commitTurn answers it turnParked (README item 96, default 241). New in v1.25.

turnCommitted.none.title: TurnCommittedNone
turnCommitted.none.description: No committed or parked turns row has this id (README item 96, default 241). New in v1.25.

turnCommitted.response.title: TurnCommittedResponse
turnCommitted.response.description: Committed, parked or none (README item 96). New in v1.25.

turnCommitted.errors.title: TurnCommittedErrors
turnCommitted.errors.description: transient alone: the same request may be sent again. New in v1.25.

turnCommitted.exchange.title: TurnCommittedExchange
turnCommitted.exchange.description: One turnCommitted request with its outcome. New in v1.25.

readWaitingStep.request.title: ReadWaitingStepRequest
readWaitingStep.request.description: The person and business's waiting step with its key (README item 97; K-09 v1.14 default 235 and open gap 215 (5)): the event step the person's walk at the business last stopped at waitsOnEvent, from the walk's own record, never inferred from the key's source alone, and whether that key is now on file. The record of the stop is in no frozen table (README open gap 109): this is the read's shape, and its home is the record that gap names. Role and scope: rosie_job on the runtime side, with no business scope, every statement naming the request's business, its own read-only transaction on its own connection on the primary, beside a Tool API call's transaction and never on it, 1 connection, the stop and its key read as one moment (one statement, or one transaction at repeatable read). Repeat: safe, a read. Time budget: inside the gate (arch 04 line 223). New in v1.25.

readWaitingStep.waiting.title: ReadWaitingStepWaiting
readWaitingStep.waiting.description: The walk waits at an event step (README item 97): S1-10 on id_checked or S1-32 on control_proven (K-09 v1.14 default 223's event table), and keyOnFile, whether that key is now on file: for id_checked the person's sign_up K-22 id_uploads row (id_uploads_one_sign_up), for control_proven the business's K-23 business_setup row holding control_proven_at with control_proven_via team_check (K-09 v1.14 default 235). New in v1.25.

readWaitingStep.none.title: ReadWaitingStepNone
readWaitingStep.none.description: The person's walk at the business waits at no event step: it never stopped at one, or the commit that walked on from it ended the stop (README item 97). New in v1.25.

readWaitingStep.response.title: ReadWaitingStepResponse
readWaitingStep.response.description: Waiting or none (README item 97). New in v1.25.

Role and scope: rosie_job on the runtime side, with no business scope, the statement naming the request's business by its primary key, its own read-only transaction on its own connection on the primary, beside a Tool API call's transaction and never on it, 1 connection. Repeat: safe, a read. Time budget: inside the event turn's gate (arch 04 line 223). New in v1.25.
